verdict.rationale: treg documents an official hosted MCP endpoint at https://treg.to/mcp and a Claude connector using OAuth with PKCE. Named MCP tools such as `review(call_id, usefulness, reason?)` and `balance` show an agent can connect and use it, and a probe confirms the server is documented on the connector page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works, and a complete MCP tool inventory or setup docs for clients other than Claude.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Authentication uses OAuth with PKCE; do not paste a Treg token or provider API key into Claude.
official MCP server documented at https://treg.to/connectors/claude
